firmware.title: Tcard_LJ6-16.3.0.150SP06-OP006PF001AZ_a15
firmware.description:
It is recommended to perform OTA upgrade when the battery is over 50%.

Update Version:
LJ6-16.3.0.150SP06(OP006PF001AZ)

Update Content:
Android Version
Upgraded from Android 15 to Android 16 for enhanced security, more features, and a better user experience.

OS Version
Upgraded from HiOS 15 to HiOS 16 for a smarter user interface and a refreshed look for your device.

Security
Updated Google Security Patch to August 1, 2026.

AI
1. AI Class Timetable: Snap or upload a timetable image from AI Gallery to automatically create a class timetable, with built-in class reminders.
2. AI Suggestions: Added three types of service cards—Local, System, and Lifestyle, and optimized transition animations.
3. Enhanced AI Search: Support summary and collection search in MindHub, as well as natural language search in Settings.
4. Upgraded NMT architecture: Faster AI subtitle generation with more accurate real-time subtitle sync for video streams.

GlowSpace Superfluid Visual Language
1. Applied a translucent glass-inspired design across the system, including the lock screen, home screen, Control Center, and system controls, with smooth and immersive animations.

Wallpapers
1. Live photos to live wallpapers: Set live photos directly as home screen wallpapers.
2. AI Theme Generator: Upload a wallpaper to automatically generate a matching system theme with similar colors and style.

Launcher
1. Added icon visualization for app download progress.
2. Added auto folder name suggestions.
3. Widget Center now includes a featured section, with a new 1×1 One-Tap Lock Screen widget.

Notifications & Control Center
1. Applied superfluid visuals and smooth animations across the system as well as seamless status bar transitions.
2. Pinned high-priority notifications for missed calls, parcel deliveries, food deliveries, and ride-hailing updates.
3. Supported notification stacking and grouping, as well as custom grouping rules for apps.
4. Designed seamless expansion animations for Wi-Fi and mobile data cards, with support for hiding switch labels in Control Center.

Privacy & Security
1. Unlock security: Changing your password, fingerprint, or face data now requires privacy password verification.
2. Unified privacy password: Manage all privacy features with one password, with support for password reset.
3. Dual System optimization: Apps can now be transferred between systems.

Communication Network
1. Intelligent acceleration in poor network conditions: Identify video calls, e-commerce, ride-hailing, and order-taking scenarios to boost network performance, and quickly restore 4G after switching to 2G/3G in elevators.
2. Optimized hotspot power consumption to reduce heat generation and battery usage when the phone is in your pocket.
3. Enhanced call recording: Support automatic recording for selected contacts, with optimized file naming.

System Performance
1. Lightweight system service architecture: Reduced overall power consumption and improved running smoothness.
2. Upgraded junk cleanup to free up storage space more accurately.

Cloud Service
1. Fully upgraded cloud services to support more types of data backup and sync.

Reminding:
1. Optimized system stability and performance while fixing other issues.
2. Visit the TECNO SPOT forum (https://tspot.tecno.com) for more information.
